chart.programText:
A = data('vllm:num_requests_running', rollup='latest').sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['service.name']).publish(label='A')
B = data('vllm:num_requests_waiting', rollup='latest').sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['service.name']).publish(label='B')
C = data('vllm:request_success_total', rollup='delta').sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['service.name']).publish(label='C')
